items.originalExcerpt: Sunny and warm weather will continue across Bulgaria on Friday, September 18, with predominantly clear skies and no precipitation expected in most parts of the country. Cloud cover will increase temporarily during the afternoon, while light to moderate easterly winds will blow. Morning temperatures will range from 9°C to 14°C in most areas, with Sofia at around 10°C....
